text:
European football presents several striking divergences between the model and Bet365 this weekend, with Serie A and La Liga offering the sharpest contrasts in expectations. Across the top five leagues, the model identifies notable value where bookmakers may be underestimating capable away sides or over-indexing on home heavyweights.

The strongest disagreement comes in Serie A, where the model gives Parma a 35.3% chance to win at Frosinone compared to Bet365's 18.2% at 5.5 odds. The model also backs Bologna strongly with a 68.9% win chance at Venezia at 2.4 odds, well above Bet365's 41.7%. In La Liga, Levante looks worth a closer look with a 73.3% model win chance against Santander at 2.0 odds, while long-shot outcomes like an Alaves win or draw at Real Madrid are rated much higher by the model than by bookmaker probabilities. Elsewhere, the model highlights Dortmund at 2.1 odds with a 66.8% chance against Leverkusen, and Brest at 3.4 odds with a 40.5% chance against Paris FC.

In the latest completed round, both sides were tested by major shocks across Europe. Bayern Munich's 1-1 draw against FC Koln and Marseille's 2-3 loss to Le Mans produced the highest log losses of the week for both the model and Bet365. Brighton's 2-0 defeat at Hull also caught predictors off guard. On the positive side, the model earned a strong hit in La Liga by correctly backing Santander to beat Sociedad where Bet365 favored the away side. It also outperformed the market on Juventus's convincing 4-0 win over Venezia and Fulham's 1-1 draw at Manchester City.
